interpretation: Original-mask rewrite advantage is reproduced on new read streams: +7.03 percentage points with equal block weights.

Fresh-mask rewrite effect is -6.13 points, with two positive blocks, one tie and five negative blocks. The descriptive interval [-14.68,+2.24] crosses zero, so this does not establish a negative population effect.
The rewrite effect is lower under fresh than original injury in seven blocks, with one tie; its equal-block change is -13.16 points.

Under fresh injury, erasure-only lowers success by 19.96 points relative to incoming, while outgoing improves by 13.83 points relative to erasure-only. These causal record contrasts are additive in rates and do not isolate independent nonlinear mechanisms.
The signed choice yields 33.39 percent and unsigned access 33.31 percent; both exceed always incoming at 28.42 percent, but the signed increment over unsigned is only 0.074 points.
This selected, exposed development cohort does not establish a general damage/resource boundary, long-horizon advantage or uniquely signed predictor.
